description: Reads a business's Google reviews and analyses them. Use it for review strategy, reply drafting or to judge review velocity. source picks free browser reading or paid DataForSEO, which is faster for large reads: about $0.0015 per 10 reviews. With source dataforseo it spends from the user's own DataForSEO account inside the extension, within the monthly cap set there; a call over the cap, or with no cap set, is refused with an error saying so, and the same request within the cache window the user set in the extension (7 days unless changed) is served from the cache for nothing. spend says what was charged (null when nothing paid was called). The agent never sees the key. Returns business (name, source, readAt, placeId, cid, primaryCategory, address, phone, website, rating, reviewCount; each null when unknown); reviews, one page of at most 100 (id, rating, text, publishedAt ISO or null, relativeAge as shown, ownerReply or null, authorReviewCount, photoCount); analytics over every review read (count, averageRating, distribution by star, monthly trend, velocity in the last 30, 90 and 365 days or null when no review is dated, responses with reply rate and median reply days, unansweredNegatives, photoShare and themes); read (how many were read); order (newest: newest first; most_relevant: the browser could not set Maps' Newest sort, so the reviews are Maps' "Most relevant" sample, which can skip recent ones; do not judge velocity, reply speed or recent negatives from it); truncated (true when the read holds fewer than the profile has, or stopped at max when the profile count is unknown); notes (why fewer were read or why the order is not newest, such as Google's signed-out view showing about five, only the Overview's reviews when the Reviews tab did not open, or Maps shown in a language other than English, which can leave the order unset; empty when nothing to say); and nextCursor: when not null, call again with it as cursor for the next page of the same read. A null rate or average means there were no reviews to compute it from.

mapsUrl.description: A Google Maps link to the place, such as https://maps.app.goo.gl/... .

placeId.description: A Google place id, such as "ChIJ...".

cid.description: A Google customer id (CID), decimal digits, as in maps.google.com/?cid=.

city.description: The town or city it is in, such as "Leeds, UK".

name.description: The business name as Google shows it.

business.description: Which business: exactly one of {mapsUrl}, {placeId}, {cid} or {name, city}. Ids from find_business or local_scan are exact; a name and city is searched in Maps and can match a different place with the same name.

cursor.description: The nextCursor from an earlier read_reviews call, to get the next page of that same read without reading Maps again. Pass the same business with it. Defaults to none, which starts a new read.

max.description: The most reviews to read, 1 to 500, newest first. Defaults to 50. With dataforseo, cost grows per 10 reviews.

source.description: browser (the default) reads Maps in the user's Chrome for free. dataforseo pays from the user's DataForSEO key kept in the extension, within the monthly cap set there.

name: read_reviews
title: Read reviews
